//: This is `routes`, not `rewrites`, on purpose. A rewrite is only consulted after Vercel has tried to serve the request from the repository root as a static file, which made every source file downloadable: /app/agent.py, /app/config.py and /requirements.txt all returned 200 in production. `routes` without a `handle: filesystem` step never consults the filesystem at all, so every request reaches the function. The dashboard is unaffected because its assets are served by FastAPI's own /static mount.
